♥ Procreate stamps compatible with Procreate only. You can scale/resize these stamp brushes, change opacity, color or set-ups.
Manga Eye stamps are elements for decorating your art work. You can use these brushes for Cartoon Portrait , Drawing Anime,Tattoo. There are 25 different styles and 30 color.

Easy to use! Download the .brushset file and import it to your brushes in Procreate. After that just choose a stamp and tap on your screen with finger or apple pencil.

♥ You will receive: 1zip
1 .brushset file with 25 stamps >> you will see file ” Manga_Eye3.brushset”
1 .swatches fils 30 colors >>> you will see file “Manga_Eye3.swatches”
presentation images

♥These brushes work with app Procreate for iPad only. They will not work in other software applications!

♥ Instant Download

♥ HOW TO USE

1. Download zip then unzip you will see Manga_eye3 folder

2 Open the folder. In folder you will see Manga_Eye3.brushset file and Manga_Eye3.swatches fils

3. Tap and hold with your finger or apple pencil

4. Both files will import directly to procreate.

5. Find the new brush set in your Brush library

♥ Another option

1. If the option “Open in Procreate” is missing, click on “More”

2. Scroll and find the option “Open in Procreate” and click on it

3. Open your project in Procreate and click on brush icon at the top right corner

4. Find the new brush set in your Brush library
